name: Farstone
description: Farstone was a world located in the Farstone system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected Farstone to the Umthyg system.
lead_paragraphs: Farstone was a world located in the Farstone system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected Farstone to the Umthyg system.

Featuring soaring mountain ranges, Farstone was sparsely populated and was at one point a mining colony, but was eventually abandoned, although nominally remaining under the control of the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex. By 43 ABY, the world was mostly inhabited by fugitives, hermits, and sociopaths.
